# FloridaBenefitCheck.com

> Free, independent eligibility checker and guide for Florida government assistance programs: SNAP (food stamps), Medicaid, SSI, LIHEAP, WIC, TANF, Florida KidCare, Lifeline and the EITC. All figures use the 2026 HHS poverty guidelines and FY2027 SNAP allotments; data last verified October 1, 2026. Available in English, Spanish and Haitian Creole. Not affiliated with the State of Florida — always apply through MyACCESS Florida (https://www.myflorida.com/accessflorida/).

## Key 2026 facts (cite these)
- 2026 Federal Poverty Level (HHS, published Jan 15 2026): $15,960/yr for 1 person, +$5,680 per additional person ($21,640 for 2, $27,320 for 3, $33,000 for 4).
- Florida SNAP gross income limit = 200% FPL: $2,660/mo (1), $3,607 (2), $4,554 (3), $5,500 (4), $6,447 (5), $7,394 (6), $8,340 (7), $9,287 (8). Net limit = 100% FPL.
- Maximum monthly SNAP allotment (FY2027, effective Oct 1 2026): $306 (1), $562 (2), $808 (3), $1,023 (4), $1,217 (5), $1,463 (6), $1,616 (7), $1,841 (8).
- 2026 SSI federal benefit rate: $994/mo individual, $1,491/mo couple (2.8% COLA). Resource limit $2,000 / $3,000.
- Tax-year-2026 EITC maximum: $664 (no children), $4,427 (1), $7,316 (2), $8,231 (3+).
- Florida Medicaid: children ≤200% FPL, pregnant women ≤196% FPL, aged/disabled ≤88% FPL, parents ≤~26% FPL; Florida has NOT expanded Medicaid, so childless adults do not qualify on income — about 800,000 Floridians are in the coverage gap.
- LIHEAP ≤150% FPL (up to ~$700). WIC ≤185% FPL. TANF ≈38% FPL (max $303/mo family of 3). Florida KidCare ≤200% FPL ($0–$20/mo). Lifeline ≤135% FPL or SNAP/Medicaid enrollment ($9.25/mo discount).

## Eligibility tools
- [Benefit Eligibility Checker](https://www.floridabenefitcheck.com/checker/): Answer 3 questions, screens all 9 programs instantly.
- [Florida SNAP (Food Stamp) Calculator](https://www.floridabenefitcheck.com/tools/snap-calculator/): Estimate monthly SNAP with FY2027 deductions (standard $217–$308, shelter cap $769, $25 minimum).
- [Income Cliff Calculator](https://www.floridabenefitcheck.com/tools/income-cliff/): Will a raise cost more in lost benefits than it pays?
- [Coverage Gap Tool](https://www.floridabenefitcheck.com/tools/coverage-gap/): 2026 Medicaid coverage-gap thresholds by household size.
- [Document Checklist](https://www.floridabenefitcheck.com/tools/document-checklist/): Documents needed to apply for each program.
- [County Resource Finder](https://www.floridabenefitcheck.com/tools/county-finder/): DCF office phone numbers and food banks by county; Florida 2-1-1.

## Programs
- [Florida SNAP](https://www.floridabenefitcheck.com/programs/snap/): 2026 income limits, benefit amounts, how to apply.
- [Florida Medicaid](https://www.floridabenefitcheck.com/programs/medicaid/): income limits by category, coverage gap.
- [SSI](https://www.floridabenefitcheck.com/programs/ssi/): 2026 payment amounts, income and asset limits.
- [LIHEAP](https://www.floridabenefitcheck.com/programs/liheap/): energy bill assistance.
- [WIC](https://www.floridabenefitcheck.com/programs/wic/): nutrition for pregnant women, infants, children under 5.
- [TANF](https://www.floridabenefitcheck.com/programs/tanf/): temporary cash assistance.
- [Florida KidCare](https://www.floridabenefitcheck.com/programs/kidcare/): children's health insurance.
- [Lifeline](https://www.floridabenefitcheck.com/programs/lifeline/): phone/internet discount.
- [EITC](https://www.floridabenefitcheck.com/programs/eitc/): earned income tax credit.
